moment: Empty stone-walled lecture hall, chalkboard with a chalk drone sketch and 'AAL IZZ WELL' lettered in the art; sunlit colonnade beside it
why: The slogan lettered on the board plus Indian sandstone campus architecture and wooden lecture benches; engineering-college setting is exactly the film's.

moment: Floating candles in a dark blue night sky or hall ceiling, one candle picked out by a teal reticle
why: Hundreds of unsupported lit candles in a night-blue void is the Great Hall ceiling image; the reticle is a UI overlay, not film.

moment: The Marauder's Map unfolded: aged folded parchment, ribbon banner, compass roses in corners, footprints
why: Folded cream parchment with ink-line corridors and walking footprints is the Marauder's Map; text areas are blank but the layout is unmistakable.

moment: Marauder's Map scrolled further down: corridors, rooms and footprint trails leading through them
why: Same fold-creased parchment with double-ruled corridors and footprint trails; reads as the map showing people moving in rooms.

moment: A tattered black ghost ship at night in fog under a moon, with a brass compass and a line drawn to it
why: Torn black sails, lit stern windows and moonlit mist read as the Black Pearl; the compass overlay recalls Jack Sparrow's compass.

moment: A silver fountain pen in a velvet-lined wooden box on a lecture desk beside a pocket stopwatch, drone chalk sketch on the board behind
why: Pen-in-a-box on a classroom desk with chalkboard and stone-sill window recalls the film's pen gift; same classroom as other frames, so I am inferring it from context.

moment: Black night sea, glowing teal breaking wave, tiny tall ship on the horizon, compass in the corner
why: Cursed-sea teal glow and a lone square-rigger on the horizon fit At World's End; Sea of Thieves is a plausible alternative.

moment: Dark candlelit stone room with floating candles, a parchment on the floor with black ink spreading like veins, castle seen through tall windows
why: Floating candles and gothic windows with a castle outside suggest Hogwarts at night; the cracked parchment is less specific.

moment: Golden-hour valley with a river and a lone horse grazing, big tree silhouetted in the foreground
why: Hazy amber sunset over mountains, grazing horse and framing oak read as RDR2's landscape and photo-mode vistas.

moment: Quiet night camp with two canvas tents and a small campfire, mountains in blue dark behind
why: Gang-camp-at-night composition with tents, stones ring fire and fireflies matches the game's camp mood.

moment: Moonlit harbour with moored tall ships and dock lanterns; below, a treasure-route map with compass, dashed trail and an X
why: Port-town masts and lantern reflections, plus compass and dashed route to X, point to pirate-adventure; the compass-and-gear icon is a branded motif.

moment: The ghost ship dimmed into the background while a framed treasure map with an X and a trail draws over it
why: Same Black Pearl-like hull; the gold-lined map panel with an X and coastline outline is a treasure-map motif.

moment: Lecture hall, chalkboard with a drone sketch and 'AAL IZZ WEL' being written
why: The slogan on the board, stone walls and benches match the film's campus classroom.

moment: Wide sunset valley framed by a dark tree, horse grazing near a river, a thin line across the lower third
why: Painterly amber vista and horse-in-the-valley framing is RDR2's look.

moment: Open sea at sunset with a distant sailing ship leaving a glowing teal wake; the treasure-route map below
why: Square-rigger on a horizon with an eerie teal wake and an X-marks-the-spot map reads pirate-fantasy.

moment: Red-sky homestead with a gnarled tree and fence; a white line passes through pink X target marks along the fence
why: Burnt-red sky over a farmhouse with crow flock, plus X target marks linked by a line, recall the game's Dead Eye targeting.

moment: A hand-built quadcopter hovering in front of a sandstone arcaded college building, with a drone icon and a pill button
why: Homebuilt flying camera in an Indian-style engineering campus recalls Rancho's flying camera; weaker than the classroom frames.

moment: The Great Hall: long tables with gold plates, floating candles under a gothic ceiling and a tall blue window
why: Floating candles over long house tables in a gothic hall is the Hogwarts Great Hall.

moment: Wooden notice board with pinned weathered posters, one large blank cream poster in the middle
why: Western wanted-poster board suggests the genre and RDR2's bounty posters, but nothing here is specific to one title.

moment: The Black Pearl-like ghost ship under a moon, a dotted gold trail running to an X on the water
why: Torn black sails and glowing stern windows with a dotted route and X recall a pirate chart.

moment: Great Hall with candles floating overhead, tables laid with golden plates
why: Floating candles and house tables under a gothic window are the Great Hall.

moment: Crimson dusk over a homestead, crows overhead, X marks scattered in the sky

moment: Silver pen in an open velvet box and a pocket stopwatch on a polished desk, blurred chalkboard with a drone drawing
why: Pen gift on a classroom desk; I am inferring this from the matching classroom set.

moment: Stormy sea with a teal breaking wave above a compass-and-trail map
